I've got two bookmarklets that I use when submitting links. The first bookmarklet grabs the URL of whatever page I'm on and opens a Voat "submit link" page with that URL already filled in. The second bookmarklet grabs the URL of whatever page I'm on and opens a page with Archive.is that archives the URL.

>javascript:void(open('https://voat.co/submit?linkpost=true&url='+encodeURIComponent(document.location)))

>javascript:void(open('https://archive.is/?run=1&url='+encodeURIComponent(document.location)))

Since both bookmarklets perform similar functions and each opens in a new tab, is there any way to combine both functions into one bookmarklet that would open both results in two new tabs?
Can someone help me combine these two bookmarklets?

try this:

javascript:(function(){window.location= 'https://archive.is/?run=1&url='+encodeURIComponent(document.location);window.open('https://voat.co/submit?linkpost=true&url='+encodeURIComponent(document.location))})()

Chrome (if you are using it) will scream at you if you try to open more than one tab at a time, so the above solution will replace the current page with the archive.is page (for reference) and open a new tab with the voat.co submit link page.
